item.description:
• Open Quickly finds notes by name and folder first. Type "work index" to find the index note in your work folder
  • Turn on Contents in Open Quickly, or press Tab, to search the text inside notes
  • Link to Note opens the same search, so the note you want is quick to find
  • Links include the folder when two notes share a name, so they open the right one
• Command click a link in a list or to-do list to open it

• Select several notes in the list with Command or Shift click, then move them to a folder or the trash together
  • Undo and redo moving or trashing notes with Command Z, including notes dragged onto a sidebar folder
  • Copy File URL for notes and folders, with a small Copied message for every copy action
  • Tags now appear together with the note as you switch notes
  • A narrower note list that leaves more room for writing

• Turn any folder into a board: drag cards between columns, add or rename columns, and open a card in a side panel
  • Type : and two letters to pick an emoji, or type a full shortcode like :tada:
  • A menu bar icon for a quick new note and your recent notes from any app, which you can turn off in Settings
  • Select several notes and folders in the sidebar and drag them into a folder together
  • A tidier sidebar that lists folders, with a + next to search for a new note or board
  • Assistants connected through MCP can read boards and move cards

• First release of Notemall: fast notes for Mac, kept as plain Markdown files in a folder you choose
  • Type / to add headings, to-dos, tables, callouts, code and images
  • Link notes with [[ and see every note that links back
  • Pick a day for a note and it comes back in Today, with Upcoming and a calendar
  • Folders, tags, themes and ⌘K to find or create anything
  • Ask your notes with Apple Intelligence, and connect assistants through MCP
